origin_id.description: A unique identifier for this item in the batch, used to correlate results and as a stable identifier for matching existing courses.

type.description: `EXTERNAL` indicates that the content is not sent to the LMS, but the `course_url` links to the content in your system.

title.description: The title of the course revision.

description.description: A description of the course revision.

course_url.description: URL to the course page. For content providers, this should be a deeplink into your product that allows users to access the course directly.

thumbnail_url.description: URL to the thumbnail image for the course.

duration.description: The duration of the course in minutes.

items.description: IETF language tag (BCP 47) in the format "ll-CC" (e.g., "en-US", "de-DE") or "ll" (e.g., "en", "de").

languages.description: A array containing the supported languages for the course content. If only one language is accepted by remote tool we default to the first one.

items.description: Array of courses to create or update.
